record.paper_title: Open problems in the theory of completely positive and copositive matrices
record.context_brief: graphs with cpr(G) equal to tf(G)
record.original_question: Characterize the graphs G for which cpr(G) = tf(G). Here cpr(G) is the maximum cp-rank over all completely positive realizations A of G, a completely positive realization of G is a matrix A in CP_n whose graph G(A) is G, and tf(G) is the maximum number of edges in a triangle-free subgraph of G.

evidence.quote: It is an open problem to find a complete characterization of those graphs for which cpr(G) = tf(G).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
For a positive integer $n$, let $CP_n$ denote the cone of $n\times n$ completely positive matrices, i.e., matrices $A$ that can be written as $A = BB^T$ for some entrywise nonnegative (not necessarily square) matrix $B$. The cp-rank of $A\in CP_n$, denoted $\mathrm{cp\text{-}rank}(A)$, is the smallest number of columns of such a nonnegative $B$. To any symmetric matrix $A$ of order $n$ associate its graph $G(A)$ on vertex set $\{1,\dots,n\}$ in which $\{i,j\}$ with $i\neq j$ is an edge iff $A_{ij}\neq 0$ (loops are ignored). For a graph $G$ on $n$ vertices, a completely positive realization of $G$ is a matrix $A\in CP_n$ with $G(A) = G$. Define
$$\mathrm{cpr}(G) := \sup\{\mathrm{cp\text{-}rank}(A): A\in CP_n,\ G(A)=G\},$$
and
$$\mathrm{tf}(G) := \max\{|E(H)|: H \text{ is a triangle-free subgraph of } G\}.$$
It is known that $\mathrm{cpr}(G) \ge \mathrm{tf}(G)$ for every graph $G$. 

Problem: Give a complete graph-theoretic characterization of those graphs $G$ for which $\mathrm{cpr}(G) = \mathrm{tf}(G)$.
artifact.status_search_result: Recent literature on cp-rank and graph parameters (e.g., works by Shaked-Monderer and Bomze on bounding cp-rank by graph parameters and triangle-free graphs) discusses the bound cpr(G) ≥ tf(G) and equality in special cases (such as triangle-free G with no acyclic components), but no general characterization of graphs satisfying cpr(G) = tf(G) has been published. The problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Bounding the CP-rank by graph parameters
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses lower and upper bounds on cpr(G) via cc(G) and tf(G); characterizes equalities in special cases but not the general cpr(G)=tf(G) case.
status_evidence.claim: General characterization of cpr(G)=tf(G) is not given.

status_evidence.title: Triangle-free graphs and completely positive matrices
status_evidence.snippet: Studies cp-rank of completely positive matrices whose graph is triangle-free; gives cpr(A)=|E(G_A)| in certain triangle-free settings.
status_evidence.claim: Partial results are known for triangle-free graphs but not a full characterization of cpr(G)=tf(G).
